reading: cross-register reconciliation. data/corpus_v2_summary.csv (PR #78, 2026-11-18) scores the model closer on 5 of these 13 games against its own reference line, MAE 10.099 vs 9.509 points. This script's unflagged 150-game fit reproduces that figure exactly (5 of 13), and its flagged fit gives 3: the only methodological difference between the two registers is the neutral-site treatment, which re-estimates the ratings and moves 2 of the 13 rows across the line. The registers therefore do not disagree about the model — they agree, and both say the model is behind its naive reference on the slice it had never been scored against.
